name: anime-desktop
description: A shonen-flavoured look for the Claude desktop app: a frosted-glass backdrop (original speed-line, aura and stadium scenes, or your own image), marked tool rows, a power-level band and a /dojo panel.

scene.title: Backdrop scene
scene.description: The built-in backdrop: burst (speed lines and a gold aura), aura (green spirit energy) or stadium (night court and floodlights).

backdropImage.title: Your own backdrop image
backdropImage.description: Optional absolute path to a .jpg, .png or .webp you own the right to use, at most about 95 KB (the backdrop is an SVG capped near 128 KB). Leave empty for the built-in scene.
